description: Two-word brands should pass when OCR joins the brand in a surrounding token such as SENDITSPIRITS.
ocrText: VODKA SODA SPLASH OF CRAN SenditSpirits.com #SenditSpirits VODKA WITH NATURAL CRANBERRY FLAVOR AND CARBONATION 4.44% ALCIVOL 355 mL PRODUCED AND CANNED BY TRIPLE EIGHT DISTILLERY GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
